title: 在既有asset store內研究pinning、eviction與decode staging
description: 已有decoded buffer重用與decode預算；峰值可來自encoded／staging／decoded/native重疊，不應新增另一個cache。 後續候選；本研究不實作、不啟動。

acceptance_criteria.text: 只在既有store新增政策，source of truth、hash/revision/license refs及decode concurrency/caps一致。
active、retiring、pending arrivals與recording引用不能被evict；cancel／quota／decode failure不遺失有效資產。
同負載列resident與stage峰值及reload延遲，沒有證明收益即保留原政策。

evidence.result: Reviewed research basis only; future optimization is not implemented or validated

activation_policy: 保持BACKLOG；owner=null；所有criteria=false。需後續明確啟動／採納及實際證據，研究結案不自動執行。
problem: 已有decoded buffer重用與decode預算；峰值可來自encoded／staging／decoded/native重疊，不應新增另一個cache。

evidence_basis.classification: CONFIRMED BY CODE; NOT MEASURED peaks
evidence_basis.version: 以來源內版本／日期為準；不得合併R17、05d40與R21 dirty
evidence_basis.sha256_status: Bound to actual research-worktree bytes at registration; historical version scope retained
Bound to actual research-worktree bytes at registration; historical version scope retained

proposed_solution: 建立既有store所有權／pin references與decode stage生命期，僅對無active/retiring/pending/recording引用的可重建resident資料研究eviction。
alternatives: 只序列化decode或去可證冗餘copy。
新增全域cache：重複權威且增加memory，不作預設。
expected_benefit: 可能降低decode峰值與無用resident資料，保留可重現資產；效果待測。
complexity: 中；引用、取消、hash與原生decode完成競爭。
audio_quality_impact: decoded rate/channels/hash與source phase不變；不偷偷有損轉碼／降採樣。
latency_impact: eviction會增加下次load延遲，需另報cache miss／preload權衡。
compatibility_regression_risk: 刪除recording refs、未到達聲音或retiring資產可破壞重播；local disk caps不等於heap。
benchmark_plan: 同asset cold/warm、concurrent decode、cancel／dispose race、failed decode、active pin、recording保存／載入及memory fallback。
rollback_plan: 停止eviction，drain或取消decode stages，保留pins與immutable stored refs；回現有caps，必要時按hash重載但不刪使用者資產。
priority_rationale: 成本範圍較小且有既有權威可延伸；只有profile顯示asset壓力才投入。
validation_status: NOT RUN — future implementation and candidate validation
compatibility_risk: Decode/stream capabilities and quotas differ; retain existing asset-format capability checks.
regression_risk: Eviction must preserve active/retiring/pending/recording asset references and immutable pins.
